title: How does historical backfill work?
seoTitle: Historical Activities and Backfill | augo support
description: When you connect Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Apple Watch, Zwift, Strava, Rouvy or Hammerhead, augo pulls in your last 30 days of activities. For more, export your history from TrainingPeaks or Garmin, or ask us for a backfill of up to five years.
summary: By default, augo pulls in your last 30 days of activities as soon as you sign up and connect Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Apple Watch, Zwift, Strava, Rouvy or Hammerhead, usually within an hour. Need more? Export your entire history reliably from TrainingPeaks or Garmin (steps below). For other sources, email info@augotraining.com or use the in-app feedback button to ask for up to 5 years.

body.html:
What you get by default

The moment you connect a device or app, augo starts pulling in the activities you did in the 30 days before connecting. You don't need to do anything — they arrive on their own, usually within an hour.

This gives your coach a recent picture of your training from day one, rather than starting from an empty calendar.

Every source works the same way. There is no device that starts from an empty history.

Going back further

If 30 days isn't enough, say you're starting with a new coach who wants to see a full season, there are three ways to bring in more.

From TrainingPeaks or Garmin (most reliable). Export your history yourself, share the files with us through Google Drive, and we import them for you. This is also how you get more than 30 days from Garmin, because the Garmin connection itself only reaches back 30 days. See how do I bring my training history to augo?

From any other source (less reliable). For Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Apple Watch, Zwift, Strava, Rouvy or Hammerhead, we can try to pull in up to five years. Email info@augotraining.com or use the feedback button in the augo app, and tell us your full name, the email address you use in augo, which app or device your history is in, and how far back you'd like to go. We can't promise every workout will come through, so if your history is also in TrainingPeaks or Garmin, export from there instead.

Only the athlete can do an export, because it needs their own accounts. Coaches can send their athletes the guide.

If the last 30 days haven't appeared

Give it an hour after connecting. If your recent activities still aren't showing, use the feedback button in the augo app to ask for support. Tell us which device or app you connected and roughly when. We'll check the connection and re-run the import.

If your Garmin has been connected for a while and no history came in, the connection needs renewing. It was authorised before augo could ask Garmin for your past activities, so it doesn't carry that permission. Connect Garmin again from the augo app, approve what Garmin asks for, and your last 30 days arrive as usual. There is more on this in which devices and apps does augo integrate with?

faqs.question: How far back does augo import my activities?
faqs.answer: 30 days by default, for every source augo connects to: Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Apple Watch, Zwift, Strava, Rouvy and Hammerhead. For more, export your history from TrainingPeaks or Garmin and we import it, or email info@augotraining.com to ask for a backfill of up to five years from another source.

faqs.question: How long does the backfill take?
faqs.answer: Your last 30 days usually appear within an hour of connecting. If they haven't after an hour, use the feedback button in the augo app to ask for support and we'll re-run it.

faqs.question: Can my coach request my history for me?
faqs.answer: A coach can ask for a backfill from a connected source by emailing info@augotraining.com. A TrainingPeaks or Garmin export needs the athlete's own accounts, so the athlete has to do that part.

faqs.question: Why are there no old activities from my Garmin?
faqs.answer: Almost always because the connection predates augo's Garmin history import, so it was authorised without permission to read your past activities. Connect Garmin again from the augo app and your last 30 days will come in. Garmin history is limited to 30 days.

faqs.question: Can I get more than 30 days from Garmin?
faqs.answer: Not through the Garmin connection, which is limited to 30 days. Use the Garmin export instead: it downloads your whole Garmin Connect history, you share it with us through Google Drive, and we import it.
